points.quote: **Workbench** (`packages/frontend/core/src/modules/workbench`, see its README) is AFFiNE's window manager. It covers the main area and the right sidebar.
**View** (`entities/view.ts`) is one managed window, like a tab or split pane.
its own history, built on an in-memory navigable history (`utils/navigable-history.ts`); a `location$` LiveData that mirrors that history's listener;
It creates a per-view `createMemoryRouter(routes)`, using the routes from `router.tsx`, and calls `viewRouter.navigate(location)` in a layout effect. ... The matched route component renders the page.
It renders `<ViewHeader>`, `<ViewBody>` and `<ViewSidebarTab tabId icon>`. ... That is how a route's header ends up in the pane's header slot, and its sidebar tabs in the right sidebar.
The active view's URL counts as the URL of the whole app.
Only the active view's sidebar is shown. `ViewSidebarTab` calls `view.addSidebarTab` and `removeSidebarTab` on mount and unmount. If a view has several tabs, a header switcher appears.

**Browser** (`browser-adapter.ts`): ... A browser location change is pushed into the view history as `fromBrowser`. If the change was a back/forward to a known view entry, it calls `history.go(delta)` instead of pushing.
